system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: AgentRCA utilizes a structured system prompt designed using standard Markdown (Fig. 9). The default AgentRCA prompt comprises five functional modules
system_prompt_style.note: Fixed modular prompt instantiated per plant with system/fault descriptions.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: the agent receives a multivariate time window and a system prompt, containing natural-language taxonomy of potential faults
env_context_strategy.note: No repository/filesystem; context is statistical tools, not env navigation. Optional RAG over documentation is opt-in.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: To prevent context dilution and maintain the agent’s reasoning focus, the tool reports only the top 10 most anomalous signals.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Autoencoder residuals: Total window MSE=0.0939 (99th pct 0.0520 1.81x). Top residuals: ThreePhaseSeparatorAirValve MSE=0.3258

tool_count.note: Autoencoder residual, statistical shift, correlation, temporal signature; optional RAG documentation tool makes 5.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: the current scope of AgentRCA is strictly diagnostic. While the framework successfully identifies underlying faults, it does not yet recommend corrective operational actions or automate process control.
edit_primitive.note: No file editing tools; tools are read-only diagnostics.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: The “no-guidance” prompt provides the tool interfaces but does not explain their physical diagnostic roles

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: additional interfaces—such as technical documentation retrieval (Sec. 4.3) or plant-specific simulator queries—can be integrated through the same tool interface without modifying the core agent loop
protocol_standardization.note: No protocol (MCP/A2A) mentioned anywhere in the paper.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: an LLM agent iteratively queries tools, analyzes the returning numerical evidence, and updates candidate hypotheses to formulate a final, evidence-grounded diagnosis
loop_primitives.note: Default hypothesis-table variant is ReAct plus explicit hypothesis tracking; ReAct-like and unstructured variants are config ablations.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: this requires the agent to explicitly maintain a dynamic, ranked table of candidate faults
planning_granularity.note: Hypothesis table is prompt-maintained rather than a harness data structure; closest value.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: hierarchical multi-agent architectures could allow specialized agents to reason over individual subsystems
multi_agent_topology.note: Multi-agent stated as future work; default is one agent.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: AgentRCA executes this diagnostic process via a tool-augmented reasoning agent, denotedϕ.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Our reasoning framework relies on a simple, fixed prompting structure and features a modular design, supporting engineering documentation retrieval and human-in-the-loop feedback.
human_in_loop.note: HITL feedback claimed as supported but no gating mechanism described; run itself is autonomous with expert review after output.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: the agent iteratively selects these tools, inspects their outputs, updates its internal reasoning state, and refines its ranked hypothesis table
short_term_state.note: State is the reasoning transcript; hypothesis table is textual.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Rather than learning fault-specific mappings, AgentRCA performs inference-time reasoning
long_term_memory.note: Digital twin/RAG corpus are static resources, not cross-run memory.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: we enforce a maximum of 10 tool-call iterations per diagnostic window

self_verification.evidence_quote: Tool outputs are traceable, candidate diagnoses are ranked, and the hypothesis table requires the agent to track supporting and contradicting evidence before producing a final answer.
self_verification.note: Self-tracking of contradicting evidence is prompt-level; no harness-run tests, linters or judge model.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: In our experiments, all diagnoses terminated before this limit.

rollback.evidence_quote: the current scope of AgentRCA is strictly diagnostic
rollback.note: Read-only tools; no state changes to revert.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: To bound inference cost and prevent infinite reasoning loops, we enforce a maximum of 10 tool-call iterations per diagnostic window.
termination_condition.note: Model ends by submitting the final ranked diagnosis ("Diagnostic convergence and submission").

cost_controls.evidence_quote: To bound inference cost and prevent infinite reasoning loops, we enforce a maximum of 10 tool-call iterations per diagnostic window.
cost_controls.note: Iteration cap is not a token budget; no caching or routing reported.

timeouts.evidence_quote: Each diagnostic window required an average of five tool calls, 4,615 tokens, and 51 seconds of total runtime.
timeouts.note: Runtime measured, no timeout enforced; cap is on iterations.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Open-weight LLM inference was performed using vLLM [56] on a single NVIDIA A100-80GB GPU operating in bfloat16 precision.
execution_isolation.note: Tools are in-process Python analytic functions; no sandbox described.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: modular tools combine the raw data and condition-specific baselines to compute standardized evidence scores
filesystem_access.note: Agent only accesses the precomputed data/documentation exposed by tools; no general filesystem access.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Open-weight LLM inference was performed using vLLM [56] on a single NVIDIA A100-80GB GPU
network_policy.note: No network-capable actions; tools are local computations (RAG uses OpenAI embeddings, but agent has no egress).

permission_model.evidence_quote: During diagnosis, the agent ϕ iteratively selects these tools, inspects their outputs, updates its internal reasoning state
permission_model.note: Tool calls executed without authorisation step; fixed read-only tool set.

tracing.evidence_quote: it produces transparent reasoning traces that explicitly link observed symptoms to their underlying physical causes
tracing.note: Natural-language diagnosis trace; no structured per-step record format described.

replayability.evidence_quote: The code needed to reproduce the analyses will be released in a public repository upon acceptance of the paper.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: We report Top-1 and Top-2 diagnostic accuracy, measuring whether the true operating state appears as the agent’s primary or secondary diagnosis.
eval_hooks.note: Evaluation protocol on PRONTO/TEP reported with the framework; code not yet released.

guardrails.evidence_quote: this section is optionally extended with targeted diagnostic guardrails—domain-informed rules designed to reduce common zero-shot misdiagnoses
guardrails.note: "Guardrails" are prompt guidance, not enforced filters or action policies.

target_domain.evidence_quote: we introduce AgentRCA, a zero-shot agentic framework for evidence-grounded root cause analysis
target_domain.note: Industrial process diagnostics / root cause analysis domain.

open_source.evidence_quote: The code needed to reproduce the analyses will be released in a public repository upon acceptance of the paper.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: we evaluated AgentRCA across fours models spanning different deployment regimes: GPT-5-mini [49, 50], Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 [51, 52], Gemma4-31B [53], and Gemma4-E4B [53]
